title: Flow Control Method Selector
description: Ten shuffled job cards ask for the best flow-control or backdraft device and the deciding job condition; device and condition are marked separately, wrong devices get misconception hints, and a summary reviews every card.
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: gravity damper
manual damper

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Choosing a flow-control or backdraft device
learningObjectives: The learner will recommend the flow-control or backdraft device that best fits each of ten job descriptions and justify the choice by naming the deciding job condition, scoring at least 8 of 10.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); device choice with the three conditions read aloud, separate device and condition verdicts, each new card, the summary and each reviewed card announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗/½ glyphs and solid/dashed borders pair with colour; native selects and buttons reachable with Tab; Enter checks and goes on.

controls.label: Condition
controls.purpose: Choose the deciding condition from three; appears after a device is chosen

controls.label: Next card / See summary
controls.purpose: Go on after a card is resolved (Enter)

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: New shuffled round with the score cleared

controls.label: Review card
controls.purpose: Summary: show the reason for any card

rules: Each card has exactly one correct device and one correct deciding condition
The three conditions on a card are shown in a shuffled order; the device is chosen before the conditions appear
A card scores only when both selections are right on the first attempt
Wrong-device hints: A, B or C on a card that needs control while running; I on card 5; E on card 6 or F on card 5; otherwise the card's Why text
limitations: Real selections weigh cost, controls and the existing equipment together; each card isolates one deciding condition

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Recommend and justify: pair each device choice with the deciding condition, with hints targeted to the wrong answer
keyQuestions: Does this job stop backflow, set airflow once, or change airflow while the fan runs?
Why is speed control not always the right answer?
commonMisconceptions: Any damper can control airflow during operation
Speed control is always the right answer
Parallel and opposed blade dampers are interchangeable
An outlet damper saves about as much power as inlet vanes
A gravity damper works at any airflow
assessmentOpportunities: Running score 'Recommendations correct: n of 10' counts first-attempt cards with both selections right; mastery is 8 of 10.
